    Source: 'src/stmts.rs', lines 195:0-199:1
    Visibility: public -/
def stmts.statement_is_allowed
  (st : stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args) (env : condfuncs.Env) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let vc ← stmts.resolver_for args env
  let b ← stmts.reaches_condition_eval st args (some vc)
  let (st1, check) ←
    if b
    then
      do
      let check1 ←
        condfuncs.functions_evaluate st.conditions args.conditions (some vc)
          env
      ok (st, check1)
    else ok (st, false)
  stmts.effect_is_allowed st1.effect check

  (statements : Slice stmts.Statement) (args : stmts.Args)
  (env : condfuncs.Env) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← policies.denies_pass statements args env

  intro h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hst⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := h
  cases b
  · h5i_simp
    have : ok false = ok true := h
    cases ok.injEq.mp this
  · unfold policies.denies_pass policies.denies_pass_loop at hb
    have h0_le : (0#usize : Usize).val ≤ k := Nat.zero_le k
    have hQ := loop_ok (policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e)
      (fun x => x.val ≤ k) (fun y => y = false) (fun x => sts.val.length - x.val)
      (fun x r hx hr => by
        cases r
        · exact denies_pass_step sts a e st k hk hst hd hs x _ hx hr
        · exact denies_pass_step sts a e st k hk hst hd hs x _ hx hr)
      0#usize true h0_le hb
    cases hQ

end rustfs_kernel.Solution

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

theorem effect_eq_deny_self : stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq .Deny .Deny = ok true := by
  have h := stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq.spec .Deny .Deny
  simp only [decide_true] at h
  exact eq_ok_of_spec h

theorem index_usize_at_k {α : Type} (v : Slice α) (i : Usize) (k : Nat) (w : α)
    (h_idx : v.index_usize i = ok w) (h_eq : i.val = k) (h_len : k < v.val.length) :
    w = v.val[k] := by
  unfold Slice.index_usize at h_idx
  split at h_idx
  · simp at h_idx
  · rw [Slice.getElem?_Usize_eq] at *
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at *
    have h_inj := Result.ok_injective h_idx
    subst h_inj h_eq
    simp_all

theorem usize_add_one_val {i w : Usize} (h : i + 1#usize = ok w) : w.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have heq := UScalar.add_equiv i 1#usize
  rw [h] at heq
  simp only [Result.match] at heq
  exact heq.2.1

theorem denies_pass_body_done
    (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < sts.val.length)
    (i : Usize) (y : Bool)
    (hi : i.val ≤ k) (hr : policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e i = ok (.done y)) :
    y = false := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rfl
  · rename_i h_nlt
    rw [UScalar.lt_equiv] at h_nlt
    rw [Slice.len_val] at h_nlt
    change ¬ i.val < sts.val.length at h_nlt
    omega

theorem denies_pass_body_cont
    (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (k : Nat) (hk : k < sts.val.length) (hst : sts.val[k] = st)
    (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false)
    (i x' : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ k) (hr : policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e i = ok (.cont x')) :
    x'.val ≤ k ∧ k + 1 - x'.val < k + 1 - i.val := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · rename_i h_lt w_stmt h_idx w_eff h_eff h_eff_true w_allow h_allow h_allow_true h_next
    have hw_val := usize_add_one_val h_next
    have h_ne : i.val ≠ k := by
      intro heq
      have hw_eq : w_stmt = st := by
        rw [index_usize_at_k sts i k w_stmt h_idx heq hk, hst]
      subst hw_eq
      rw [hs] at h_allow
      rw [h_allow_true] at h_allow
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h_allow
      contradiction
    omega
  · rename_i h_lt w_stmt h_idx w_eff h_eff h_eff_false h_next
    have hw_val := usize_add_one_val h_next
    have h_ne : i.val ≠ k := by
      intro heq
      have hw_eq : w_stmt = st := by
        rw [index_usize_at_k sts i k w_stmt h_idx heq hk, hst]
      have h_st_eff : w_stmt.effect = .Deny := by rw [hw_eq, hd]
      rw [h_st_eff] at h_eff
      have h_eff_deny := effect_eq_deny_self
      rw [h_eff] at h_eff_deny
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h_eff_deny
      exact h_eff_false h_eff_deny
    omega

theorem denies_pass_loop_false
    (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (k : Nat) (hk : k < sts.val.length) (hst : sts.val[k] = st)
    (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false)
    (i : Usize) (y : Bool) (hi : i.val ≤ k)
    (hl : policies.denies_pass_loop sts a e i = ok y) :
    y = false := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop at hl
  apply loop_ok (policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e)
    (fun x => x.val ≤ k) (fun y => y = false) (fun x => k + 1 - x.val) _ i y hi hl
  intro x r hx hr
  cases r with
  | done y' => exact denies_pass_body_done sts a e k hk x y' hx hr
  | cont x' => exact denies_pass_body_cont sts a e st k hk hst hd hs x x' hx hr

theorem denies_pass_not_ok_true
    (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.denies_pass sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  intro h
  unfold policies.denies_pass at h
  rcases List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm with ⟨k, hk, hst⟩
  have h_false := denies_pass_loop_false sts a e st k hk hst hd hs 0#usize true (Nat.zero_le k) h
  contradiction

theorem explicit_deny_wins (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  intro h
  have h_deny := denies_pass_not_ok_true sts a e st hm hd hs
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at h
  h5i_invert h <;> {
    subst_vars
    contradiction
  }

end rustfs_kernel.Solution

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result rustfs_kernel rustfs_kernel.Spec H5iAppLib
open Aeneas.Std.WP

namespace rustfs_kernel.Solution

h5i_derive_eq stmts.Effect stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq

/-- Inversion of a `cont` step of the deny scan: it stays in bounds, advances by
one, and the statement it stepped over either is not a `Deny` or is a `Deny`
that does not apply. -/
lemma body_cont (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env) (i j : Usize)
    (h : policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e i = ok (ControlFlow.cont j)) :
    i.val < sts.val.length ∧ j.val = i.val + 1 ∧
      (∀ w, sts.val[i.val]? = some w → w.effect = stmts.Effect.Deny →
        stmts.statement_is_allowed w a e = ok true) := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop.body at h
  h5i_invert h
  · rename_i hlt w hidx b1 hb1eq hb1 b2 hallow hb2 hadd
    have hbound : i.val < sts.val.length := by
      simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv, Slice.len_val] using hlt
    refine ⟨hbound, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hspec := Usize.add_spec (x := i) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)
      have := post_of_ok hspec hadd
      simpa using this
    · intro w0 hw0 hd0
      have hw : w0 = w := by
        have hwow : sts.val[i.val]? = some w := by
          have hh := Slice.index_usize_spec sts i hbound
          rw [hidx] at hh
          have hw' : w = sts.val[i.val]'hbound := by simpa using hh
          rw [hw']
          simp
        rw [hwow] at hw0
        exact (Option.some.inj hw0).symm
      rw [hw] at hd0 ⊢
      rw [hb2] at hallow
      exact hallow
  · rename_i hlt w hidx b1 hb1eq hb1not hadd
    have hbound : i.val < sts.val.length := by
      simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv, Slice.len_val] using hlt
    refine ⟨hbound, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hspec := Usize.add_spec (x := i) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)
      have := post_of_ok hspec hadd
      simpa using this
    · intro w0 hw0 hd0
      have hw : w0 = w := by
        have hwow : sts.val[i.val]? = some w := by
          have hh := Slice.index_usize_spec sts i hbound
          rw [hidx] at hh
          have hw' : w = sts.val[i.val]'hbound := by simpa using hh
          rw [hw']
          simp
        rw [hwow] at hw0
        exact (Option.some.inj hw0).symm
      rw [hw] at hd0
      have hb1dec : b1 = decide (w.effect = stmts.Effect.Deny) := by
        have hs := stmts.Effect.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqEffect.eq.spec w.effect stmts.Effect.Deny
        rw [hb1eq] at hs
        exact (WP.spec_ok b1).mp hs
      exfalso
      have : b1 = false := by
        cases b1 with
        | false => rfl
        | true => exact absurd rfl hb1not
      rw [hb1dec] at this
      exact (decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp this) hd0

/-- The deny scan can only finish with `true` in the else branch, i.e. after the
whole slice has been visited. -/
lemma body_done_true (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env) (i : Usize)
    (h : policies.denies_pass_loop.body sts a e i = ok (ControlFlow.done true)) :
    sts.val.length ≤ i.val := by
  unfold policies.denies_pass_loop.body at h
  h5i_invert h
  rename_i hnot
  have hge : sts.len ≤ i := not_lt.mp hnot
  have hlen : sts.val.length ≤ i.val := by
    simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv, Slice.len_val] using hge
  exact hlen

/-- If the deny scan finishes with `true`, then every `Deny` statement it walked
past is one that does not apply. -/
lemma denies_pass_true_imp (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize), sts.val.length - i.val = n → i.val ≤ sts.val.length →
    policies.denies_pass_loop sts a e i = ok true →
    ∀ s ∈ sts.val.drop i.val, s.effect = stmts.Effect.Deny →
      stmts.statement_is_allowed s a e = ok true := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro i hn hi htrue s hs hdeny
    rw [policies.denies_pass_loop, Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def, H5iAppLib.bind_tc_eq_ok] at htrue
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hk⟩ := htrue
    cases r with
    | cont j =>
      simp only [] at hk
      have htruej : policies.denies_pass_loop sts a e j = ok true := by
        unfold policies.denies_pass_loop; exact hk
      obtain ⟨hbound, hj, hhead⟩ := body_cont sts a e i j hr
      have hw : sts.val[i.val]? = some (sts.val[i.val]'hbound) := by simp
      have hhead' := hhead (sts.val[i.val]'hbound) hw
      have hdrop : sts.val.drop i.val = sts.val[i.val]'hbound :: sts.val.drop j.val := by
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hbound, ← hj]
      rw [hdrop] at hs
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with hs | hs
      · rw [hs] at hdeny ⊢
        exact hhead' hdeny
      · exact ih (sts.val.length - j.val) (by omega) j rfl (by omega) htruej s hs hdeny
    | done b =>
      simp only [] at hk
      have hb : b = true := by simpa using hk
      subst hb
      have hle := body_done_true sts a e i hr
      have hdrop : sts.val.drop i.val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hle
      rw [hdrop] at hs
      exact absurd hs (by simp)

theorem explicit_deny_wins (sts : Slice stmts.Statement) (a : stmts.Args) (e : condfuncs.Env)
    (st : stmts.Statement) (hm : st ∈ sts.val) (hd : st.effect = .Deny)
    (hs : stmts.statement_is_allowed st a e = ok false) :
    policies.policy_is_allowed sts a e ≠ ok true := by
  have hdp : policies.denies_pass sts a e ≠ ok true := by
    intro htrue
    have h0 := denies_pass_true_imp sts a e sts.val.length (0#usize)
      (by simp) (by simp) htrue st (by simpa using hm) hd
    rw [hs] at h0
    exact absurd h0 (by simp)
  intro hpol
  unfold policies.policy_is_allowed at hpol
  rw [H5iAppLib.bind_tc_eq_ok] at hpol
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hk⟩ := hpol
  cases b with
  | false => simp at hk
  | true => exact hdp hb

end rustfs_kernel.Solution
